blocks.text: This module intends to enhance participants' comprehension of flexibility as an essential competency for adjusting to changes in the workplace. Learners will investigate the traits of flexibility, such as quick decision-making, adaptable thinking, and a willingness to embrace innovation. The goal of the module is to bolster participants' capacity to handle unforeseen circumstances, rearrange priorities, and react proactively. Furthermore, learners will explore methods including effective time management, cultivating a growth mindset, and preparing for change.

Some people are flexible when it comes to changing everyday routines, while others can easily make changes to their business appointments or vacation plans. However, there are also many for whom any kind of change causes them stress and irritation. Research in neuroscience does not place the skill of flexibility in specific brain centers, and it seems to be a very sophisticated skill that is particularly useful in managing our daily lives. Flexibility in a work environment is undoubtedly one of the most beneficial and necessary qualifications. It is a skill that offers significant advantages to both the individual employee and the company itself. Especially, work flexibility is the ability to easily adapt and respond immediately to any form of change (Arnsten, 2009).

Flexibility is a skill that every employee who wants to feel useful and irreplaceable must have. By allowing him/her to better manage his/her projects and obligations by making quick maneuvers in urgent situations. Since someone aims for career advancement and professional recognition, he/she must have flexibility in his/her "quiver". The more flexible someone is, the easier it is to initially "survive" and then to stand out in his/her workplace. At the same time, an employee who feels productive has less stress and certainly increases the levels of satisfaction he/she receives from the work environment (Cascio & Montealegre, 2016).
Flexibility has the following characteristics, especially in the workplace (Griffin et al., 2007):

items: Quick responses to changes, like market changes, customer demands
Adaptive philosophy, which is a characteristic of people who can immediately redefine needs, identify opportunities, and turn to new plans and approaches.
Adaptation to continuous technological development, political and social uncertainty, and intense competitiveness by being able to find alternative options.

blocks.text: Some steps to develop sustainability include the following:

blocks.definition: The prioritization of different tasks can help you manage time and adapt to new data or situations.
A mindset that is open to change and continuous progress can help you positively develop flexibility and experience changes.
Being ready for changes rather than waiting for change to happen can help you become more flexible.

blocks.term: Be open to innovation and technology
blocks.definition: Being open to the use of cutting-edge tools enhances the ability to adapt to different situations and be flexible.

blocks.text: Some of the challenges related to flexibility and the solutions to it are the following:

blocks.definition: Resistance to change (Dweck, 2006) Solution: Adopt a mindset that promotes being open to new ideas.
Poor time management (Claessens et al., 2007) Solution: Train in developing effective time management skills

blocks.text: Solution: Focus on skill development (digital skills, communication skills) to be ready for any change that may occur.

blocks.title: Try it
blocks.text: Try a scenario-based role play. Write on paper about unexpected situations in the workplace, like project delay, change of leadership. Then the participants will choose one situation and discuss what they would do in such a case. All participants will write down their approach, and in the end, they will choose the most effective scenario. They will explain in detail the reasons why they chose these steps.
The following questions can help you understand if you are flexible.

items: Am I open to innovation and new tools?
Can I stay calm and adapt quickly when unexpected situations arise?
Am I open to working with different teams or under different leadership styles?

blocks.text: The ability to be flexible can be crucial to our success in the working environment. Flexibility in a work environment is undoubtedly one of the most beneficial and necessary qualifications. Each employee should be ready to adapt to new data and unexpected events. This will help him/her to gain confidence and be productive. Staying open to the changes and continuously informed about new skills and trends are some steps that can help in the development of flexibility.

By the conclusion of this module, participants will understand the significance of being flexible when facing workplace challenges and changes. They will show enhanced capability to adjust swiftly, maintain a proactive approach, and react efficiently to unforeseen circumstances. Participants will be more prepared to implement time management techniques and embrace an innovative mindset. Moreover, learners will recognize typical obstacles to flexibility and strategies to overcome them.
